about: Advisories CI's npm audit (scripts/ci/npm_audit.py) lets pass until a day, each with why it cannot reach a person who installs Kranto. Remove an entry once a fixed version is in the lockfile.

exceptions.why: a slow match on crafted glob patterns, in the build and test tools only (vite, vitest, svelte-check, through fdir and tinyglobby) with the repository's own patterns; the wheel carries the built page, never these packages; no fixed version exists yet (<= 4.0.7, the newest)
